material_peer_challenges.remedy: Defend every seam from epistolary form, discourse transition, and closure evidence while preserving the larger alternative.

material_peer_challenges.claim: Do not detach accusation from escalation, interlocutor turns from answers, or the Rom.3.9-Rom.3.20 catena from its accountability close.

material_peer_challenges.remedy: Defend each launch, interlocutor, question-answer, citation-frame, and closure seam while preserving the larger parent.

material_peer_challenges.remedy: Defend question-answer, example, premise-inference, and closure seams, including the Rom.4.1 hold, without doctrinal or law-scheme authority.

material_peer_challenges.remedy: Defend analogy-to-application, question-to-answer, and assurance-chain seams, especially the listed textual hot zones.

material_peer_challenges.claim: Keep lament, examples, objections, citations, proclamation, remnant, olive branches, mercy, and doxology available as one full argument.

material_peer_challenges.remedy: Defend the full argumentative sequence and every hot-zone seam without identity, election, Israel, supersessionism, or doctrinal authority.

material_peer_challenges.claim: Base seams among mercies/body/gifts, love imperatives, governing authorities, neighbor love, and time exhortation only on paraenetic form and rhetorical transition.

material_peer_challenges.remedy: Defend the four-unit route and Rom.12.11/13.1 holds without ethics, government, obedience, resistance, gender, or office authority.

material_peer_challenges.remedy: Defend the 15.21/15.22 seam and Rom.15.24, 15.29, and 15.31 hot zones without historical or audience authority.

material_peer_challenges.remedy: Defend the four seams and all Rom.16 hot zones without gender, office, identity, or doxology-placement authority.
